versions.changelog:
- Added automated test coverage with new test files for core engine and markdown storage.
- Improved de-ambiguation phase documentation: strictly enforces "one question at a time" protocol in SKILL.md.
- Enhanced clarity on question style, topic sequence, and interaction rules for plan initialization.
- Internal changes in CLI and engine source files to support updated workflow and testing.

- Added .pyc (compiled Python) files to the src/__pycache__ directory for initialization, CLI, engine, and markdown store modules.
- No changes were made to the documentation or feature set.

- Initial release of secretary-skill, a procedural tool for effective long-term planning and execution.
- Introduces a three-stage pipeline: de-ambiguation, vertical splitting, and cron automation.
- Provides CLI commands for setting and refining goals, breaking them into actionable tasks, scheduling, alignment, and status tracking.
- Integrates with automation engines via a JSON-based Cron Bridge for reminders and progress monitoring.
